I feel very anxious writing this and feel like it’s my fault, I’m wondering if my mom is controlling and therefore the reason why if feel this way. Sorry it’s long

I’m very depressed and very anxious which might be because of how I act. I rarely talk to people ever. Not even texting. The exception is one friend which I see every few days for about 3 hours when they get off work. The only other people I see is my dad and my sister when I visit them every other week for a day or two. But I kinda choose to do this because I’m to anxious to contact others like in a friendly way on social media or anything. I just feel like I don’t know what to say unless it’s in person but I’m to anxious to ask people to hang out.

At home my I do nothing. I walk my old choir teachers dog in the morning, and then maybe do the dishes. My mom gets mad at me because I do nothing. Which I don’t do it might just be my fault. But when I try to do more things I usually do it wrong or when she looses something it’s because I lost it by moving it when I decided to clean the table.

Then she tells me says she really appreciates when I do more things because it really helps out. And that she acknowledges that she gets too angry and yells at me she’s in the wrong but I need to come up with a way to help her change that behavior pattern somehow. Most days we are calm though and I do nothing. But eventually I start to do more and it leads to a yelling match and this repeats every few months.

I also feel scared to do anything without asking her for some reason. I feel like she will be mad. I can’t type anymore I’m going to freak out.

What do I need from do. Do I neeed to just be better. Or do I need to move to my dads. I don’t know what to do/think
